How it works

  1. Create a leaderboard and add the team names.
  2. After each round, type the points into the round table — Enter jumps to the next team.
  3. Show the standings between rounds and the podium at the end of the night.

Questions & answers

How do I fix a wrong score?

Click the number in the round table and type the correct one, or press Ctrl+Z to undo the last change.

Can I run a quiz every week?

Yes. End the game to save the result in the history, then start the next quiz on the same board — or duplicate it.

Can guests see who is leading?

Yes. The ranking is always sorted by total points, and the TV can switch between the ranking and the round table.
